name: post-independence-indian-conflicts
summary: One ontology. Campaigns, incidents, actors, and families are JSON. Research agents write record files only; the map reads them. A campaign is a span. An incident is a day inside a campaign. Colour is Conflict.family. Counts are claims with ranges and sources.

fields.name: public name
fields.scale: small | medium | large — map encoding, not UCDP
fields.family: legend type: interstate | naxal | naga | bodo | northeast | kashmir | punjab | communal | external | integration
fields.northeast: boolean filter for the Northeast lens
fields.time: TimeSpan with FuzzyDate start/end, ongoing flag

fields.kind: attack | ambush | bombing | raid | massacre | riot | air-strike | operation | assassination | clash | siege | kidnapping | other
fields.casualties: CasualtyClaim list — min/max/best, of, claimedBy, contested
fields.reports: NewsReport list — outlet, headline, excerpt, url, optional imageUrl

fields.kind: state | military | paramilitary | insurgent-group | militia | foreign-state | political-party | …

rules: Do not invent a single death integer. Store min/max/best with sources.
Never plot a village marker for a state-level fact. GeoPrecision controls the point.
Maoist / Naxal campaigns are revolutionary-insurgency and internal. Northeast insurgencies are northeast: true. They are not External terror.
External terror is types includes terrorism AND internalExternal is external, transnational, or mixed, and not northeast, not revolutionary-insurgency, not communal-riot.
docs/*.json and docs/*.md are research notes. The map reads campaigns.json, incidents.json, naxal-events.json, actors.json, families.json.
Research agents write records into the JSON files in this folder. They do not edit React, CSS, or map components.
Map color is Conflict.family → families.json. Scale is marker size only.
